title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1973-09-24
source: Lineage is MAR(w/Harmon Kardon mics @ the board) > R @3 & 3/4 ips; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Nice 1973 audience tape of a solid show, though opinions on the audio vary.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a pleasant 1973 audience sound that many listeners find enjoyable, and the performance is generally regarded as good, with one reviewer calling it a great show. However, another fan feels the music is merely okay and questions why the tape receives high ratings, suggesting the audio is only average.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers note a decent performance and acceptable audio; one gives 5 stars while the other rates it 3, averaging to an overall 4‑star rating with moderate confidence due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'nice' 1973 audience tape; no specific issues mentioned, but another reviewer calls it merely okay, indicating decent clarity without standout fidelity.
